title: Bound daily private conversation participants
requirements: Default 10 distinct private users per local calendar day, configurable 0..1000; the same user does not consume additional participant slots.
Persist daily admissions through restart; atomically enforce cap and reset by configured timezone day.
Deny excess or failed admission before ledger ingestion, perception, guard, reply and memory extraction; group chat and disabled private admission keep existing boundaries.
Compose persistent quota in BotApp and expose configuration in env example and management UI.
